basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Radiation and its Effects on MicroElectronics and Photonics Technologies (RADMEP)
basic_details.offering_entity: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) & RADMEP Consortium
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne (France), University of Jyväskylä (Finland), KU Leuven (Campus Geel, Belgium), Université de Montpellier (France)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Microelectronics, Semiconductor Hardware, Radiation Effects, Photonics Technologies, Embedded Systems, and Nuclear/Space Instrumentation.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~18 to 22 prestigious Erasmus Mundus scholarship grants awarded globally per cohort
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally under Partner Country quota; typically 2 to 3 Pakistani scholars selected per intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2 full academic years across multiple European countries)

nationality_requirements: Open to candidates from all countries worldwide, including Pakistan (Partner Country category)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age limit under Erasmus Mundus programme rules.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science (BS / BSc 16-year) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Applied Physics, Materials Science, or Computer/Semiconductor Engineering with minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 (80%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; competitive candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.70 / 4.00 with exceptional physics and circuit analysis grades.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial coursework in electromagnetism, solid-state physics, semiconductor device fundamentals, electronic circuits, and optics/photonics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating by July 31 preceding September intake.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research in semiconductor labs, hardware fabrication, or cleanroom exposure provides a competitive advantage.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Official IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each sub-score) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 90). MOI certificates are not accepted by RADMEP consortium.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Consortium languages (French, Finnish, Dutch) are not required; coursework is 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Erasmus Mundus NDICI / IPA III Partner Country scholarship quota applies to Pakistani nationals.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Candidates who have previously benefited from an Erasmus Mundus Master or Doctoral scholarship are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver across all partner universities (EUR 18,000 for non-EU students).

admission_application_fee.details: Direct application via RADMEP consortium portal is free of charge.

accommodation.details: Covered directly from the EUR 1,400 / month living allowance; university housing reserved in Saint-Étienne, Jyväskylä, and Geel.

monthly_stipend.details: EUR 1,400 / month tax-free living allowance for up to 24 months (total EUR 33,600 | ~PKR 425,000 / month).

airfare.details: EUR 3,000 per year travel contribution for Partner Country students living >4,000 km away.

visa_fee.details: EUR 1,000 installation grant covers visa processing, medical attestations, and initial arrival logistics.

health_insurance.details: Full worldwide comprehensive health, emergency, and travel insurance meeting Erasmus+ requirements.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly EUR 1,400 living stipend plus access to subsidized campus dining across France, Finland, and Belgium.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to specialized semiconductor textbooks, IEEE Xplore digital library, and cleanroom protective gear.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full university library and cleanroom access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Funded master thesis placements with industrial partners such as CERN, ESA, Airbus, STMicroelectronics, and Thales.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Mobility travel grant between consortium host nations.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Covered via Erasmus mobility travel budget

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions (Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne, University of Jyväskylä, KU Leuven Campus Geel, Université de Montpellier).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Leading European centers for nuclear instrumentation, radiation testing, and semiconductor photonics; CERN and ESA accredited partners.
available_majors: Semester 1 (UJM): Fundamentals of Microelectronics and Photonics
Semester 2 (JYU): Radiation Effects on Components and Systems
Semester 3 (KU Leuven / Montpellier): Advanced Reliability / Photonic Devices in Harsh Environments
Semester 4: Master Thesis with Industrial or Research Partner (CERN, ESA, STMicroelectronics)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree in Electronics, Physics, or Electrical Engineering (CGPA >= 3.50/4.00), official IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 90), CV, motivation statement, and two academic references via online portal.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single consolidated application for the entire consortium; rigorous assessment on semiconductor physics and math background.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight laboratory experience in semiconductor fabrication, radiation physics, optics, or embedded hardware in your personal statement.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the RADMEP portal, complete personal and academic history, upload attested transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, English test scorecard, and register two academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review RADMEP mobility track, syllabus, and partner universities on the official portal.
Step 2: Prepare attested academic transcripts, degree certificate, Europass CV, motivation letter, and IELTS/TOEFL scorecard.
Step 3: Register on RADMEP online application portal and fill application fields.
Step 4: Submit online application before the scholarship deadline (January 20).
Step 5: Consortium Selection Committee reviews applications and scores candidates based on technical background and academic grades.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates attend an online technical interview in February.
Step 7: Consortium publishes ranking and submits nominations to the European Commission (EACEA) in March.
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification issued in April; visa documentation and acceptance letters dispatched.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: One single unified application covers both consortium degree admission and Erasmus Mundus scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two university academic professors directly via referee invitation link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Max 2-page statement explaining passion for semiconductor technology, microelectronics reliability, radiation environments, and alignment with RADMEP objectives.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief outline of desired thesis focus (space electronics, nuclear instrumentation, or high-energy physics sensors).
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass format CV detailing academic history, laboratory experience, engineering tools, and honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview with consortium professors testing knowledge in semiconductor physics and circuit design.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 90+.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via RADMEP consortium portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Materials Science.
Complete transcripts showing all subjects, credit hours, and grades with minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00.
Europass format CV highlighting hardware projects, lab skills, and publications.
Structured statement of purpose detailing interest in radiation effects, semiconductor hardening, and photonics.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight long-term impact for technological development.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from university professors submitted directly through portal.
Official IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 90) test certificate.
Valid Pakistani passport copy valid for at least 2 years.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Scholarship applications close January 20; self-funded applications accepted until May.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (Academic performance in physics, semiconductor devices, and circuit analysis)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Quality of final year project, cleanroom experience, or published papers)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of technical goals and alignment with space/nuclear radiation focus)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint Academic Committee comprising professors from UJM, JYU, KU Leuven, and UM.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Standardized multi-criteria evaluation matrix covering academic excellence, physics fundamentals, and motivation.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in electronics or applied physics with solid mathematical foundations, circuit simulation skills, and semiconductor device physics knowledge.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from GIKI, NUST, UET Lahore, FAST-NUCES, and PIEAS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Italy, Spain, Brazil, Turkey, Colombia, Vietnam.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply via the official RADMEP portal https://master-radmep.univ-st-etienne.fr/.
Beware of commercial agencies claiming to guarantee Erasmus Mundus scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for the RADMEP Erasmus Mundus scholarship is 100% free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: The consortium does not cooperate with educational agents or commercial recruiters.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Apostille and HEC degree attestation charges in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
Initial French student visa application fee prior to arrival (covered via €1,000 installation grant).
Inter-country mobility travel expenses (funded via €3,000/year travel grant).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need prior knowledge of French or Finnish. Reality: The entire curriculum is delivered 100% in English across all 4 host institutions.
Myth: You must have space agency experience to qualify. Reality: Outstanding foundational knowledge in electronics and semiconductor physics is what is evaluated.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party blogs claim that MOI certificates are accepted; the RADMEP consortium strictly enforces official IELTS or TOEFL score reports.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass at least 60 ECTS credits each academic year to proceed between mobility universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time participation in all laboratory exercises, radiation facility visits, and industry workshops.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Consortium review board evaluates progress at the conclusion of each academic semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in full-time external employment that interferes with full-time academic study.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of scholarship and recovery of unspent funds in case of withdrawal or academic misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Mobility semesters are structured; semester 3 specialization choice is finalized during semester 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Not applicable to joint master's programme.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship duration is strictly fixed at 24 months.
